About Dave

Serial Entrepreneur.
Podcast Host.
Misfit.

Dave Lukas has built and scaled multiple multi-million dollar companies — including Grasp Technologies (Inc 5000), co-owner of TaxPlanIQ (fast-growing tax savings software), and founder of 12 Minute Trading (trading education, programs & community for entrepreneurs), GainStacker (automated SPY options directives — 98.9% live win rate, 10 min/day), and the WealthStacker System (probability-based wealth building).

For 10+ years, Dave has been sitting down with the world's top founders and pulling out the real story — the non-traditional methods, the Inner Misfit, and the 21 uncomfortable truths that consistently separate those who break through from those who stay stuck.
